why_this_target: One of three parallel packets closing Clause 11. 11.7.2 Segments is the conceptual core: it defines the ordering model that the whole of 11.7, and every synchronization statement in the language, depends on. A misclassification there does more downstream damage than anywhere else in the clause.

findings.source_text: p1: 'the value of each element shall be positive and not greater than the number of images in the current team, and there shall be no repeated values.' p2: 'its value shall be positive and not greater than the number of images in the current team.'
findings.issue: The packet's own compound sweep correctly identified separate positive and upper-bound obligations, but the catalogue collapsed them into single facets array-image-set-out-of-range-source-violation and scalar-image-set-out-of-range-source-violation. The sweep and the catalogue contradicted each other, and the 'no repeated values' obligation was not carried separately.
findings.precedent: Compound-obligation precedent (C1161): a compound shall sentence can carry more than one obligation.
findings.closure: Closed in cf1fff9. The array case (p1) now carries a positive/in-range control plus separate nonpositive, too-large and repeated-value facets; the scalar case (p2) carries a control plus separate nonpositive and too-large facets. All are source-control; no diagnostic expectation was added, because these are value requirements on the program rather than constraints a processor is required to diagnose.
findings.reviewer_verification: Re-verified; the rendered compound sweep now agrees with the catalogue.

findings.source_text: 11.7.2 p3 otherwise bullets: 'it shall not be referenced, defined, or become undefined ... unless the segments are ordered'; 'that subobject shall not be referenced, defined, or have ... inquired about ... unless the segments are ordered'; 'the effective argument shall not be referenced, defined, or become undefined ... unless ...'. 11.7.5 p4: 'Execution of the cooperative synchronization ... shall include a dependency ... The mechanisms available for creating such a dependency are processor dependent.'
findings.issue: Both units were dispositioned permission, but each contains normative shall restrictions. Only the atomic/event/notify exceptions in 11.7.2 p3, and only the 'mechanisms ... are processor dependent' sentence in 11.7.5 p4, are genuine latitude.
findings.precedent: Processor latitude is a permission, never a requirement, and the check runs in BOTH directions: a requirement misfiled as a permission is exactly as much a defect as the reverse. Also engages the rule distinguishing a permission from a merely absent restriction.
findings.closure: Closed in cf1fff9 by SPLITTING rather than re-dispositioning, since each unit genuinely mixes both. 11.7.2 p3 -> p3.atomic-event-notify-permissions (permission, covering only the three may-exceptions) and p3.otherwise-ordering-restrictions (requirements, covering the three shall-not bullets). 11.7.5 p4 -> p4.dependency-requirement (requirements) and p4.processor-dependent-mechanisms (permission). The p3 and p4 parents became structural.
findings.reviewer_verification: Re-verified. The reviewer specifically confirmed the structural parents are NOT silently emptied of content - they map to the split requirements and are backed by declared subunits - and independently re-read 11.7.2 to confirm no other ordering shall remains disposed as mere definition or permission.
findings.why_it_mattered: 11.7.2 defines the ordering model on which all of 11.7 depends. Treating its shall-not restrictions as processor latitude would have propagated a false permission through every synchronization section.

implementability.split_before_correction: 26 / 24 / 22 (72 facets); the two facets added by the C117SR-001 correction are source-control
implementability.principle: This suite has no multi-image capability. A facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if a conforming processor is REQUIRED to reject, and an executable oracle only if a conforming SINGLE-IMAGE program can PORTABLY OBSERVE the effect. A dynamic multi-image synchronization obligation satisfies neither.
implementability.classified_unimplementable: Synchronization actually occurring, waiting and release, segment ordering and precedence, timing, scheduling, interleaving and progress, team membership runtime state, and any failure-dependent behaviour - a failed or stopped image cannot be portably induced.
implementability.both_directions_audited: The reviewer was required to report over-suppression as readily as under-suppression, on the standing principle that an unobservability claim which is too broad is itself a defect. The reviewer would not reclassify any existing facet in either direction: local syntax, constraint diagnostics, coindexed and dependency checks, and local value-domain controls remain implementable or source-control rather than buried under a blanket multi-image disclaimer.
